messages:
ryan (AE): MavenBridge sent an RFI this morning. They want a 2-week POC into their VPC, BYOH HSM (PKCS#11), 7yr audit retention, embeddings ~80 QPS and generation ~30 QPS. They asked for a capability matrix, a short test plan, and ballpark POC pricing. Need a draft by EOD tomorrow.
ana (Sales Eng): Quick clarifiers: region? embeddings/gen token lengths? Will they accept Redwood-managed HSM as fallback?
ryan (AE): Region: us-east-1. Embeddings seq ~512, gen avg 200 tokens. They prefer BYOH but will accept managed fallback for day 1.
jordy (Solutions): I'll draft the capability matrix mapping requirements to our features: BYOH PKCS#11, Redwood-managed HSM fallback, VPC peering patterns, audit retention options, and a risks column. I'll attach the BYOH playbook and a sample deployment snippet.
pi (SRE): Heads-up blockers to call out: PKCS#11 over peering adds ~5-15ms per crypto op; HSM throughput needs validation (add ops/sec test); peering provisioning 24-48h. For the POC capacity, 3x A10x with workload-aware batching should meet targets. Also note audit storage/TCO for 7yr retention.
ana (Sales Eng): Preliminary POC estimate (placeholder): 3 GPUs x 2 weeks = $13,500; peering/onboarding = $2,000; SE support (2 days) = $3,000; audit storage incremental ~$140/mo. Will refine after matrix.
jordy (Solutions): Example config snippet I'll include in attachments:
```
deployment:
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.0.8.9:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555  # ~7 years
```
artifact-bot: uploaded: "BYOH-HSM-playbook-v7.pdf" to /internal/playbooks (link placeholder)
pi (SRE): I'll add a short test-plan to validate: HSM ops/sec under load (target 200 ops/sec headroom), p95 gen latency at 200 tokens, embeddings QPS at 80 under steady load, and audit log delivery + retention lifecycle. Also include fallback plan: use Redwood-managed HSM with customer key import and note SLA differences.
ryan (AE): Good. Please drop the draft into /sales/mavenbridge/rfi-draft and tag me. Procurement wants a one-page summary they can share with legal. Need final packet by Friday COB. Thanks team :pray:
